# Danh mục module của zoo (DLNet 1.2.0)

137 module, 11 decoder phân đoạn (unet, unetpp, fpn, deeplabv3, deeplabv3plus, pspnet, linknet, upernet, segformer, fcn, deconv). Nguồn và kết quả đối chiếu với mã gốc: [THIRD_PARTY.md](../THIRD_PARTY.md). Kiểu tensor và combinator: [architecture.md](architecture.md#kho-module-zoo).

| op | in kinds | out | tags | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `act` | vec,seq,ser,map,vol | same | act | torch.nn; modular_deep_learning (escort) |
| `afno` | map | same | attn | NVlabs/AFNO-transformer afno/afno2d.py AFNO2D (Guibas et al., arXiv:2111.13587) |
| `afno_block` | map | same | block | NVlabs/AFNO-transformer classification/afnonet.py Block (mixing afno) |
| `attn_seq` | seq | same | attn | prescient-design/cortex self-attention with pre-norm and residual inside |
| `avgpool` | ser,map,vol | same | primitive | torch.nn.AvgPool1d/2d/3d, for paper cards |
| `basic_block` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | rasbt/deeplearning-models BasicBlock; pytorch/vision resnet |
| `bottleneck` | ser,map,vol | same | block,down | rasbt/deeplearning-models Bottleneck; pytorch/vision resnet (ResNeXt: groups, Wide: base_width) |
| `cbam` | map | same | attn | huggingface/pytorch-image-models layers.CbamModule |
